mapping.draft_py:
# Elvish Reclaimer (M20).
# s1 "This creature gets +2/+2 as long as there are three or more land cards in your graveyard."
#    Thieves' Guild Enforcer's conditional static (B5a-aslong-opp-gy-count, C9: the "as long as"
#    lives in StaticAbility.condition) with who/zone = you/your graveyard, inner_filter = land
#    cards, count 3, and the self pump +2/+2.
# s2 "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice a land: Search your library for a land card, put it onto the battlefield
#    tapped, then shuffle." Portcullis Vine's "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice a <thing>" cost
#    (B5c-cost-sacrifice-defender) with a land, and Fabled Passage's search-to-battlefield-tapped
#    + shuffle (B5c-cost-sacrifice-search) over "a land card"; SEARCH without the controller role
#    (MAPPER_GUIDE, divergence D12).
static = StaticAbility(
    effect=A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
        'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=2)),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
        'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=2)),
    }),
    condition=FAtom(
        pred=FAtomPred.ZONE_COUNT_GE,
        count=QConst(value=3),
        who=ControllerRef.YOU,
        inner_filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Land'),
        zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
    ),
)
reclaim = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(
        parts=(
            CostManaGeneric(amount=QConst(value=2)),
            CostSacrifice(
                target=Selector(
                    count=QConst(value=1),
                    mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                    filter=FAnd(
                        children=(
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Land'),
                        ),
                    ),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                ),
            ),
            CostTap(),
        ),
    ),
    effect=Seq(
        steps=(
            A(Verb.SEARCH, {
                'cards': Selector(
                    count=QConst(value=1),
                    mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                    filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Land'),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
                ),
                'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
                'tapped_on_enter': True,
            }),
            A(Verb.SHUFFLE, {'zone': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.YOU)}),
        ),
    ),
)
abilities = [static, reclaim, *compiled]

clauses.clause: This creature gets +2/+2 as long as there are three or more land cards in your graveyard.
{2}, {T}, Sacrifice a land: Search your library for a land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

mapping.notes: G1's board has no land cards in the graveyard or library, so neither the +2/+2 nor the search result shows there.
